title: 三年前全美追他：如今他改写了一代人，黑子反而成了燃料？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's been a long day, but thank you all for being here.
segments.zh: 今天很漫长，但感谢大家到场。

segments.en: I really appreciate it. This is a long time coming. I started our relationship again, and Jackson, when Coach Prime was playing there, he's now in Colorado and fresh off a win.
segments.zh: 非常感谢。这酝酿已久。我重新开始了我们的关系，杰克逊，当普莱姆教练在那里打球时，他现在在科罗拉多，刚赢了一场。

segments.en: We should just start there. I wonder, three years ago, when Prime first got there, he's the center of the college football universe.
segments.zh: 我们就从那里开始吧。我想知道，三年前，当普莱姆刚去那里时，他是大学橄榄球宇宙的中心。

segments.en: What do you all remember about that time? Just when so much media attention was on there, you have 60 minutes, you have everybody flying in.
segments.zh: 你们还记得那个时候吗？当时那么多媒体关注，有60分钟，所有人都飞过来。

segments.en: What do you remember about that time, Kyle? It was all you on TV all the time, too.
segments.zh: 凯尔，你对那个时候还记得什么？当时电视上全是你。

segments.en: It was a blur. No, what I remember, and I still remember, are the haters.
segments.zh: 一片模糊。不，我记得，而且现在还记得的，是那些黑子。

segments.en: And I love them, because they just fuel us.
segments.zh: 我爱他们，因为他们只会激励我们。

segments.en: They're the reason that you just want to win even more, because they're not looking at the full picture, and not looking what he's doing to raise a generation,
segments.zh: 他们就是你更想赢的原因，因为他们没有看到全貌，没有看到他在做什么来培养一代人，

segments.en: or next generation. So that's the fun part.
segments.zh: 或者下一代。所以那才是有趣的部分。

segments.en: That's what I'll always remember. I remember several things.
segments.zh: 那是我永远会记得的。我记得好几件事。

segments.en: One, I remember that, and what I wish people would appreciate, is as Flynn Boeen, at any time you give yourself a name, Prime,
segments.zh: 我记得，我希望人们能理解的是，就像弗林·博恩，任何时候你给自己起个名字，Prime，

segments.en: and you actually answer to it when people call you that?
segments.zh: 当人们这样叫你时，你真的会回应吗？

segments.en: Coach, right. Coach, right. He's quotables.
segments.zh: 教练，对。教练，对。他很有名言。

segments.en: I mean, he had a coach, right? But he cares.
segments.zh: 我是说，他有个教练，对吧？但他很关心。

segments.en: Yeah. And I just know how I knew, and I know how much he cared about the athletes, because he wants to make them better men, just not better football players.
segments.zh: 是的。我知道我是怎么知道的，我知道他有多关心运动员，因为他想让他们成为更好的人，而不仅仅是更好的足球运动员。

segments.en: Right. And he's lived an incredibly full life.
segments.zh: 对。他度过了非常充实的一生。

segments.en: I remember that, and I came from a HBCU. I went to Texas Southern University.
segments.zh: 我记得，我来自一所传统黑人大学。我上了德克萨斯南方大学。
